newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lukang to offer 80 mln A shares at 6.30 yuan each.
newsitem.headline: Lukang to offer 80 mln A shares at 6.30 yuan each.

text.p: Shandong Lukang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Monday it was set to launch an initial public offering of 80 million A shares on the Shanghai bourse on January 23.
The offer, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been priced at 6.30 yuan per share, the firm said in a prospectus in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
China Guotai Securities Co Ltd has been named as the issue's lead underwriter, it said.
Lukang, based in the city of Jining in eastern Shandong province, produces penicillin and some pharmaceutical raw materials.
Lukang said it aims to use 488 million yuan it expects to rais from the offering to continue construction of a project designed to turn out 1,000 tonnes of penicillin a year.

Lukang said it forecast net profits of 103.18 million yuan for 1997, compared with 87.46 million yuan estimated for 1996 and 65.96 million yuan booked for 1995. It said it had after-tax profits of 65.98 million yuan for the first 10 months of last year.

After the offer, Lukang would have 298.65 million shares, composed of 119.1645 million state shares, 57.8717 million legal person shares, 41.6138 million staff shares and 80 million domestic A shares.
